thesis: Howard Marks argues that while avoiding losers is a valid strategy, investors must also consciously choose between focusing on defense (fewer losers) or offense (more winners) rather than assuming one approach is superior. He illustrates this dilemma using a tennis analogy, noting that while players must balance offense and defense to avoid losing points, even less skilled players should not abandon all offensive attempts.
